# PRACTICE DIRECTION 41A – PROVISIONAL DAMAGES

# This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41] Contents of this Practice Direction

## Claims for provisional damages

## 1.1

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 1.1] CPR Part 16 and Practice Direction 16 set out information which must be included in the particulars of claim if a claim for provisional damages is made.

## Judgment for an award of provisional damages

## 2.1

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 2.1] When giving judgment at trial the judge will:

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 2.1] (1) specify the disease or type of deterioration, or diseases or types of deterioration, which

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 2.1] (a) for the purpose of the award of immediate damages it has been assumed will not occur, and

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 2.1] (b) will entitle the claimant to further damages if it or they do occur at a future date,

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 2.1] (2) give an award of immediate damages,

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 2.1] (3) specify the period or periods within which an application for further damages may be made in respect of each disease or type of deterioration, and

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 2.1] (4) direct what documents are to be filed and preserved as the case file in support of any application for further damages.

## 2.2

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 2.2] The claimant may make an application or applications to extend the periods referred to in paragraph 2.1(3) above 1 .

## 2.3

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 2.3] A period specified under paragraph 2.1(3) may be expressed as being for the duration of the life of the claimant.

## 2.4

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 2.4] The documents to be preserved as the case file (‘the case file documents’) referred to in paragraph 2.1(4) will be set out in a schedule to the judgment as entered.

## 2.5

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 2.5] Causation of any further damages within the scope of the order shall be determined when any application for further damages is made.

## 2.6

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 2.6] A form for a provisional damages judgment is set out in the Annex to this practice direction.

## The case file

## 3.1

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 3.1] The case file documents must be preserved until the expiry of the period or periods specified or of any extension of them.

## 3.2

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 3.2] The case file documents will normally include:

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 3.2] (1) the judgment as entered,

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 3.2] (2) the statements of case,

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 3.2] (3) a transcript of the judge’s oral judgment,

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 3.2] (4) all medical reports relied on, and

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 3.2] (5) a transcript of any parts of the claimant’s own evidence which the judge considers necessary.

## 3.3

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 3.3] The associate/court clerk will:

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 3.3] (1) ensure that the case file documents are provided by the parties where necessary and filed on the court file,

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 3.3] (2) endorse the court file

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 3.3] (a) to the effect that it contains the case file documents, and

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 3.3] (b) with the period during which the case file documents must be preserved, and

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 3.3] (3) preserve the case file documents in the court office where the proceedings took place.

## 3.4

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 3.4] Any subsequent order:

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 3.4] (1) extending the period within which an application for further damages may be made, or

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 3.4] (2) of the Court of Appeal discharging or varying the provisions of the original judgment or of any subsequent order under sub-paragraph (1) above,

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 3.4] will become one of the case file documents and must be preserved accordingly and any variation of the period within which an application for further damages may be made should be endorsed on the court file containing the case file documents.

## 3.5

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 3.5] On an application to extend the periods referred to in paragraph 2.1(3) above a current medical report should be filed.

## 3.6

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 3.6] Legal representatives are reminded that it is their duty to preserve their own case file.

## Consent orders

## 4.1

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 4.1] An application to give effect to a consent order for provisional damages should be made in accordance with CPR Part 23. If the claimant is a child or protected party 2 the approval of the court must also be sought and the application for approval will normally be dealt with at a hearing.

## 4.2

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 4.2] The order should be in the form of a consent judgment and should contain:

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 4.2] (1) the matters set out in paragraph 2.1(1) to (3) above, and

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 4.2] (2) a direction as to the documents to be preserved as the case file documents, which will normally be

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 4.2] (a) the consent judgment,

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 4.2] (b) any statements of case,

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 4.2] (c) an agreed statement of facts, and

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 4.2] (d) any agreed medical report(s).

## 4.3

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 4.3] The claimant or his legal representative must lodge the case file documents in the court office where the proceedings are taking place for inclusion in the court file. The court file should be endorsed as in paragraph 3.3(2) above, and the case file documents preserved as in paragraph 3.3(3) above.

## Default judgment

## 5.1

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 5.1] Where a defendant:

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 5.1] (1) fails to file an acknowledgment of service in accordance with CPR Part 10, and

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 5.1] (2) fails to file a defence in accordance with CPR Part 15,

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 5.1] within the time specified for doing so, the claimant may not, unless he abandons his claim for provisional damages, enter judgment in default but should make an application in accordance with CPR Part 23 for directions.

## 5.2

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 5.2] The Master or district judge will normally direct the following issues to be decided:

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 5.2] (1) whether the claim is an appropriate one for an award of provisional damages and if so, on what terms, and

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 5.2] (2) the amount of immediate damages.

## 5.3

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > 5.3] If the judge makes an award of provisional damages, the provisions of paragraph 3 above apply.

## ANNEX

## (Example of an award of provisional damages after trial)

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > (Example of an award of provisional damages after trial)] (Title of proceedings)

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > (Example of an award of provisional damages after trial)] THIS CLAIM having been tried before [title and name of judge] without a jury at [the Royal Courts of Justice or as may be] and [title and name of judge] having ordered that judgment as set out below be entered for the claimant

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > (Example of an award of provisional damages after trial)] IT IS ORDERED –

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > (Example of an award of provisional damages after trial)] (1) that the defendant pay the claimant by way of immediate damages the sum of £…………… (being (i) £………….. for special damages and £…………. [agreed interest][interest at the rate of …… from………..to…………] (ii) £………….. for general damages and £………….. [agreed interest][interest at the rate of 2% from……… to………..] and (iii) £…………… for loss of future earnings and/or earning capacity) on the assumption that the claimant would not at a future date as a result of the act or omission giving rise to the claim develop the following disease/type of deterioration namely [set out disease or type of deterioration]

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > (Example of an award of provisional damages after trial)] (2) that if the claimant at a further date does develop that [disease][type of deterioration] he should be entitled to apply for further damages provided that the application is made on or before [set out period]

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > (Example of an award of provisional damages after trial)] (3) that the documents set out in the schedule to this order be filed on the court file and preserved as the case file until the expiry of the period set out in paragraph (2) above or of any extension of that period which has been ordered

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > (Example of an award of provisional damages after trial)] (4) (costs)

## SCHEDULE

[This practice direction supplements CPR Part 41 > SCHEDULE] (list documents referred to in paragraph (3))

## Footnotes

## 1. See CPR rule 41.2(3). Back to text

## 2. See Part 21 for the meaning of ‘child’ and ‘protected party’. Back to text
